summary.en: Focus and breaks, in rhythm. A menu-bar work timer that nudges you to stand when focus time is up. Auto-switches on lock/sleep, unlocks back to focus. Hotkeys, hot corners, open at login, and today’s session totals—light, always there, never in the way.
